title: DCP Quadrature Conjugate-Pair Holevo Audit: Exact Bloch-Disk Holevo Capacity, Randomized X/Y Fisher Isotropization Bounds, and Singlet Phase-Independence

theorems.name: Exact Single-Pair Holevo Capacity on Z_q
theorems.statement: For any symmetric noise kernel K_eta on Z_q and non-zero difference d in {1, ..., q-1} with harmonic visibility lambda_d, the uniform secret average of rho_d(s; K_eta) is I_2 / 2 and the exact Holevo capacity is chi_d(K_eta) = 1 - h_2((1 + |lambda_d|)/2) bits.

theorems.name: Exact SLD Quantum Fisher Information and Conjugate X/Y Classical Fisher Envelope
theorems.statement: For any lambda_d in (-1, 1) and phase theta in [0, 2*pi), the SLD quantum Fisher information is constantly I_Q(theta; lambda_d) = lambda_d^2, while the 50/50 sigma_X/sigma_Y quadrature classical Fisher information satisfies lambda_d^2 / 2 = I_XY(0; lambda_d) <= I_XY(theta; lambda_d) <= I_XY(pi/4; lambda_d) = lambda_d^2 / (2 - lambda_d^2) < lambda_d^2.

theorems.name: Two-Copy Singlet Phase Independence and Noise-Purity Estimation
theorems.statement: For two independent copies rho_d(theta; lambda_d) tensor rho_d(theta; lambda_d), the singlet projection probability <Psi^-|rho_d tensor rho_d|Psi^-> = (1 - lambda_d^2)/4 and triplet probability (3 + lambda_d^2)/4 are identically independent of theta, while <00|rho_d tensor rho_d|11> = (lambda_d^2 / 4) * e^(-2 i theta).
